name: Debug Push Permissions

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - develop
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  pull-requests: read
  issues: read

jobs:
  debug-branch-protection:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Log Environment Details
        run: |
          echo "=== Environment Details ==="
          echo "Runner OS: ${{ runner.os }}"
          echo "Runner Arch: ${{ runner.arch }}"
          echo "GitHub Ref: ${{ github.ref }}"
          echo "GitHub Sha: ${{ github.sha }}"
          echo "GitHub Actor: ${{ github.actor }}"
          echo "GitHub Event Name: ${{ github.event_name }}"
          echo "Repository: ${{ github.repository }}"
          echo "Branch: ${{ github.ref_name }}"

      - name: Check Auth Status
        run: |
          echo "=== Auth Status ==="
          echo "GITHUB_TOKEN is set: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN != '' }}"
          # Attempt to list repos to verify token validity
          curl -s -H "Authorization: token ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}" https://api.github.com/user/repos?per_page=1 | jq -r '.[0].full_name // "Failed to fetch repos"'

      - name: Fetch Branch Protection Rules
        env:
          BRANCH: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          echo "=== Branch Protection Rules ==="
          echo "Fetching protection rules for branch: $BRANCH in repo: $REPO"
          
          # Get the branch protection settings
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GH_TOKEN" \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/branches/$BRANCH/protection")
          
          if [ "$RESPONSE" = "null" ] || [ -z "$RESPONSE" ]; then
            echo "No protection rules found or branch does not exist."
          else
            echo "$RESPONSE" | jq '.'
            
            # Check specific rules
            echo "=== Required Status Checks ==="
            echo "$RESPONSE" | jq '.required_status_checks'
            
            echo "=== Enforce Admins ==="
            echo "$RESPONSE" | jq '.enforce_admins'
            
            echo "=== Required Pull Request Reviews ==="
            echo "$RESPONSE" | jq '.required_pull_request_reviews'
            
            echo "=== Restrictions ==="
            echo "$RESPONSE" | jq '.restrictions'
          fi

      - name: Check User Permissions
        env:
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          ACTOR: ${{ github.actor }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          echo "=== User Permissions ==="
          
          # Check if the actor has push permissions
          RESPONSE=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GH_TOKEN" \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.v3+json" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/collaborators/$ACTOR/permission")
          
          echo "Permission for $ACTOR: $RESPONSE"

      - name: List Recent Commits
        run: |
          echo "=== Recent Commits ==="
          git log --oneline -10
